issues.failure_explanation: For a bi-Lipschitz map on R^n with Lip(rho^{-1}) <= L, the correct lower volume bound is m(rho(E)) >= L^{-n} m(E), not L^{-1} m(E). The inequality used holds only for n=1. For n>=2, take rho to be scaling by 1/L: then m(rho(E)) = L^{-n} m(E) < L^{-1} m(E). The same slip appears in m(rho(dE)) <= L m(dE), which is harmless because the right side is 0. With the correct factor the density constant becomes 1/(L^{4n} sigma) rather than 1/(L^{3n+1} sigma). The stated covering constant N <= 4^n L^{3n+1} sigma therefore does not follow from Lemma whitney_covering_lemma. The correct bound is 4^n L^{4n} sigma.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the volume distortion factors by L^n (m(rho(E_j)) >= L^{-n} m(E_j)) and restate the covering constant as N <= 4^n L^{4n} sigma. The rest of the proof and the application to the explicit Whitney set go through unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit covering-constant bound in the lemma is unsupported for n >= 2. In the paper's application (n = 2) the exponent is wrong, but the qualitative conclusion that the covering constant is finite and the construction in Example ex:explicit_whitney_partition is a Whitney set survives. Only the numerical dependence of N on L is affected.
issues.title: Wrong volume distortion factor for bi-Lipschitz maps in dimension n (L instead of L^n)
issues.why_classification: This is a local one-line correction of an exponent; every qualitative claim and the Whitney property of the explicit source points are preserved.
